key_insight: Primer uses multi-agent AI to help instructors create adaptive educational simulations grounded in their materials, goals, and knowledge of students.
engineering_relevance: Its open-source, LLM-agnostic design supports customization and deployment with different models, including local models, under varied governance requirements.
method: Instructors supply subject knowledge, lesson goals, and student context.
A multi-agent system carries instructional intent through the simulation experience.
Generative AI produces responsive variations of student practice.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes the framework and release of its prompts and code but reports no quantitative evaluation or learning outcomes.
watch_item: AI-generated scenarios require validation for instructional alignment and reliability, especially when switching underlying models.
paper_title: Primer: An AI Framework for Instructor-Centered Educational Simulation Creation
